topography.project_purpose: Merchant Moe is a decentralized exchange (DEX) on Mantle that uses a Liquidity Book model for efficient trading. It also offers staking and yield farming through its MOE token and related contracts.
topography.relationship_narrative: The LBFactory creates and manages liquidity pools, while the Moe token is used for governance and incentives. Staking and farming contracts (MasterChef, MoeStaking, VeMoe) interact with the Moe token to distribute rewards, and the JoeDexLens provides on-chain data for the DEX.
